unidade: B1.2 · Unit 7 — Calls and video calls

licoes.objectivo: Relatar afirmações com say / tell e a mudança de tempos.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: Kagiso said he [would] send a price by Wednesday.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: He [said] they had installed sensors at three mines.

opcoes.texto: She told me she was busy.

opcoes.texto: He said they'd installed sensors at three mines.
He said we installed sensors at three mines.
He said they have installing sensors at three mines.

exercicios.enunciado: Ele disse que ia enviar o preço na quarta-feira.
exercicios.resposta: He said he would send the price on Wednesday.

opcoes.texto: The insurance company had accepted the claim.

exercicios.frase: She said she was happy with the report.

Think of a conversation you had last week. Report three things the other person said.
exercicios.frase: said
exercicios.resposta: Last week I had lunch with my old colleague Ana. She said she'd changed jobs in January, and she was much happier now. She told me her new office was in Talatona. And she said she would call me when her company needed an accountant.

exercicios.enunciado: Do you prefer to call people or to send messages? Why?
exercicios.frase: prefer
exercicios.resposta: I prefer to call, because it's faster and people understand my tone. But for numbers and addresses, I send a message, so the person has them in writing.

exercicios.enunciado: Ele perguntou se podíamos pagar adiantado.
exercicios.resposta: He asked if we could pay in advance.

exercicios.frase: This is Nuno. Kagiso asked if we wanted the alert software too.

exercicios.frase: He asked how many sensors we needed.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita: "asked" com som de "t" no fim.
Think of a job interview, a visit to a bank or a call with a client. Report three or four questions the person asked you.
exercicios.frase: asked
exercicios.resposta: When I opened my bank account, the manager asked me a lot of questions. She asked where I worked and how much I earned. She asked if I had another account, and whether I wanted a credit card. In the end, she asked when I could bring my documents.

exercicios.enunciado: Is it fair for a supplier to ask for fifty percent in advance? Why?
exercicios.frase: because
exercicios.resposta: In my view, it depends. For a new client, it's fair, because the supplier doesn't know them yet. But for an old client, thirty percent is enough. Our company normally pays thirty days after delivery.

licoes.objectivo: Relatar pedidos e ordens com ask / tell + pessoa + to, e usar explain that, promise to, agree to.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: Sílvia asked me [to get] the price in writing.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: She told me [not to pay] anything in advance.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: Kagiso [promised] to send a sample sensor.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.

exercicios.enunciado: "Pediu-nos para enviar um relatório todas as sextas." Em inglês:

opcoes.texto: She asked us to send a report every Friday.
She asked us send a report every Friday.
She asked to us to send a report every Friday.

exercicios.enunciado: Choose the correct sentence.

opcoes.texto: He explained that the software was included.
He explained me that the software was included.
He explained to the software was included.

exercicios.explicacao: explain não leva a pessoa directamente: explained (to me) that…

exercicios.enunciado: Lerato: "Call Kagiso again tomorrow." Report it.

opcoes.texto: She told me to call Kagiso again.
She told me call Kagiso again.
She said me to call Kagiso again.

exercicios.enunciado: Ele prometeu enviar uma amostra.
exercicios.resposta: He promised to send a sample.

exercicios.frase: I'm Nuno. Lerato asked us to send Ingrid a weekly report about the sensors, every Friday.
exercicios.enunciado: What did Lerato ask them to do?

exercicios.frase: She told me not to pay anything in advance.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita, com "to" fraco.
Report two things your manager, a teacher or a doctor asked you to do this week, one thing they told you not to do, and one promise.
exercicios.frase: asked me to
exercicios.resposta: On Monday my manager asked me to prepare the budget for March, and she told me to send it by Thursday. She told me not to include the new office, because it isn't approved yet. And she promised to give me a day off next week!

exercicios.enunciado: Do you prefer instructions in writing or by phone? Why?
exercicios.frase: prefer
exercicios.resposta: I prefer instructions in writing, because I can read them again later. Last month my manager told me to change a report by phone, and I forgot one detail. Now I ask people to send me an email.

opcoes.texto: I'm afraid she's in a meeting. Can I take a message?
Can you leave her a message for me?

exercicios.enunciado: How do you say "@" in an email address?
"Fala o Nuno" (ao telefone). Em inglês:

exercicios.frase: This is Nuno. My number is plus two four four, nine two three, four five six, seven one eight.

exercicios.frase: A, E, I. G, J. H, Y, W.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita as letras que mais confundem.
You call a supplier, but the person isn't there. Leave a complete message: who you are, who it's for, what it's about, what you want, and your number.
exercicios.frase: This is
exercicios.resposta: This is Rosa Neto, from Kwanza Logistics in Luanda. Could you ask Mr Daniel Ferreira to call me back this afternoon? It's about the invoice for January. My number is nine one two, three four five, six seven eight. Could you read that back to me, please?

exercicios.enunciado: What is more difficult for you in English: a phone call or a video call? Why?
exercicios.frase: because
exercicios.resposta: For me, a phone call is more difficult, because I can't see the person's face. On a video call, I can see if they understand me. And on the phone, numbers and names are really hard.

Describe your last video call or online meeting: who was in it, what problems you had, and what you said.
exercicios.frase: mute
exercicios.resposta: Last week I had a video call with a client in Lisbon. At first, she was on mute, so I said: "You're on mute!" Then my connection was bad, and I broke up. In the end, we got cut off, and I had to send her the link again.

exercicios.enunciado: Do you think video calls are as good as face-to-face meetings? Why?
exercicios.frase: face
exercicios.resposta: Not really. Video calls save time and money, but face-to-face meetings are better for difficult conversations. You can see people's reactions, and there are no connection problems!

licoes.titulo: Real English: Sorry, you broke up
licoes.objectivo: Seguir uma videochamada com problemas de ligação e identificar o que ficou combinado.

Lerato asks you to report the call to Sílvia. What did Kagiso say, and what did he promise?
exercicios.frase: said
exercicios.resposta: Kagiso said the software was free for the first year. He explained that the sensors would arrive on the third of March if we ordered this week. He promised to call us on Wednesday about the payment, and he said the sample would arrive on Thursday.

exercicios.enunciado: What do you do when the connection is bad in an important call?
exercicios.frase: If
exercicios.resposta: If the connection is bad, I turn off my camera first, because that helps. I say what I lost — "Sorry, you broke up" — and at the end, I check everything in writing, by email.

Report a call with a chair supplier: price 90 dollars a chair; at first, delivery in four weeks; you asked for two; in the end, three; a free sample next Monday; they asked if you could pay half in advance.
exercicios.frase: asked
exercicios.resposta: She said the price was ninety dollars a chair. At first, she told me the delivery would take four weeks. I asked if they could do it in two, and in the end, she agreed to deliver in three. She promised to send a free sample next Monday, and she asked if we could pay half in advance.

exercicios.enunciado: Pass on this note to a foreign supplier, in English: "Por favor diga ao fornecedor: precisamos de 50 cadeiras até ao dia 20; pagamos 40% na encomenda e o resto na entrega; e pedimos que levem as cadeiras velhas. — A Direcção"
exercicios.frase: says
exercicios.resposta: Our director says we need fifty chairs by the twentieth. We can pay forty percent when we order, and the rest on delivery. And the director asks if you could take away the old chairs.

Report a phone call you had recently: what did the other person say and ask?
exercicios.frase: asked
exercicios.resposta: Yesterday my cousin called me from Benguela. She said she had a new job at the port, and she told me she was very happy. She asked if I could visit her in April, and she asked when my holidays were. I promised to call her back this weekend.

exercicios.enunciado: A colleague calls, but your manager is in a meeting. Take the message and read it back: the colleague wants a call back today about the invoice; number 912 345 678.
exercicios.frase: just to check
exercicios.resposta: I'm afraid she's in a meeting. Can I take a message? … OK. So, just to check: you'd like her to call you back today about the invoice, and your number is nine one two, three four five, six seven eight. Is that right?
